capabilities.name: Canonical Wiki identities and source publications
facts: Stable logical article ID independent of title or slug; exact global or organization ID and sending-church/network kind for each source.
Immutable source revision number, safe body, content hash, title, excerpt, content type, phase, section, slug, published state/time and meaningful-update designation.
Related/parent/guide references resolve canonical identities; global revisions name their reference generation, organization revisions name the upstream revision they edited.
Current per-organization article state distinguishes inherited, published edit, hide and draft; current version and expected publication revision; attributed author and correction/publish history.
Meaningful revision lineage preserves an unread earlier meaningful update through later typo-only edits.
Each changed published global revision has an upstream notice identity and exact current organization editor audience, including typo-only revisions; notice intent is committed with publication.
invariants: Unique revision identity within article and source; immutable content hash cannot change under that identity.
Organization sources and editorial state belong to the same exact organization and kind; same-title additions have different canonical IDs.
Global content admits only the fixed safe MDX grammar; organization nodes never execute MDX code.
Current source entitlement gates every body, draft, historical revision, excerpt and citation. A hide denies its own hidden body and suppresses default reads.
Upstream notices are in-app only and cannot silently adopt or overwrite organization edits/hides.
capabilities.retention: Tenant-owned content survives creator-account deletion with minimal attribution. capabilities.name: Explicit plant Wiki source preference order
facts: Plant identity, separate sending-church and sending-network order groups, expected order revision.

Recognition episode identifies rejoining as a new unranked candidate; attributable explicit order changes retain history.
invariants: No duplicate, foreign-plant or wrong-kind order entries; positions are unique within one group.
Per-article resolution considers sending churches first, then networks, then global; inactive/inherited/missing entries fall through.
Competing sources without an explicit order remain source_order_required; no implicit name/date/join-order winner.
Rejoining does not recover prior rank automatically, and source preference grants no other authority.

observations.observation: Reading completion/history needs provenance, but bookmarks and helpfulness expose only current own state. Uniform created/updated timestamps and separate historical copies for every personal state are not all required. Visible statistics derive from current entitled corpus.

Order revision, exact recognition/rank and publication/hide lineage are required. Repeated per-entry timestamps/revisions need a concurrency or user-history reason; preference is the first ranked entry, not another stored preference flag.

TOC, breadcrumb and read-time estimates can derive from safe content/topology. related_article_ids is relational meaning rather than opaque data; minimizing columns cannot hide constrained identity links in JSON. Immutable global source bundles can remain packaged bytes with exact manifests.

Release/chunk/template hashes and activation history have real consumers. Only candidate build-state needs mutability; validated bytes do not need duplicate revision/updated state, and active release derives from the last activation rather than a second active flag.

Original saved bytes/hash/MIME, owner, frozen template/input provenance and truthful upload/finalization states are required. Generic generated scope branches and repeated metadata need an actual supported account/plant operation; organization Wiki editing alone is not document ownership.

The requirement admits exactly account or plant ownership. Generic organization ownership fields add unused states, while current revision, archive, core_values designation and immutable copy/import lineage are necessary. Plain text can derive from safe editor nodes unless a named search query justifies a stored derivative.

Demand, leased attempt, immutable captured run and current publication have different identities and must remain distinguishable. Separate plant/organization run structures share much execution metadata; that duplication is not a requirement to copy the retry engine, but protected subject/result shapes must retain exact integrity.

Snapshots and model output need immutable history and exact contributor lineage. Display scorecards/focus/trends are views, not separate records. Queryable audience/category/severity/rank/finding targets and constrained contributor links are not opaque JSON even when narrative model output is.

The 253 Evry features do not imply 253 storage shapes. Conversation events, candidate drafts, immutable reviewed proposals, approval witnesses and effect receipts supply shared state; native operations reuse their own entities. Repeated generic scope/revision/timestamp fields on immutable child records require a concrete integrity/history consumer.

Conversation handle ownership/expiry and domain binding are required, while actual byte metadata and cleanup claims can reuse shared upload/object/job lifecycle. No second attachment byte store or provider-specific runtime platform is required.
